title: Pick 1 to 50: Why Every AI Says 27
topic: LLMs are not random number generators
audience: Everyday phone/PC/AI users who have seen this quirk themselves
whyCare: Participatory; small competitor numbers (12-1.9K) so a clean execution has room.

evidence.claim: The Register (2025-06-30): ChatGPT, Claude Sonnet 4, Gemini 2.5 Flash and Llama 4 all answered 27 to "guess a number between 1 and 50"; Grok said 42 (accessed 2026-10-23)

competitors.title: Why AI keeps picking 27

angle: Frame 0: '1-50' number grid + hook; viewer picks. Twist: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Llama all said 27. Why: they predict the most likely answer, and humans' 'random' picks (odd, not too round, contains 7) dominate the text they learned from. Loop: 'Your turn: pick a number from 1 to 50.'
strengths: Frame-0 puzzle the viewer can answer or check (week-3 brief rule); loopable ending
weaknesses: Results vary run to run; say "in The Register's test".
